title: The fox astronomer
alt: A red fox in brass glasses observes through a telescope in a moonlit rooftop observatory.
description: A richly layered character scene with precise paw contact, an astronomical instrument and warm workshop lighting.
prompt: A richly detailed animated-film illustration of an anthropomorphic red fox astronomer inside a cozy rooftop observatory. The fox wears a navy waistcoat and round brass glasses, has one fluffy attached tail, and looks through the eyepiece of a complete brass telescope mounted on a stable wooden tripod. One paw steadies the telescope, the other rests naturally on a small star-chart table. Shelves of books, rolled blank charts, a moonlit circular window and a glowing green lamp form a layered set. Beautiful fur, coherent character anatomy and telescope construction, sophisticated warm-and-cool cinematic light, no text.
